summary: A single message in the nightshift-placed-orders queue is repeatedly failing in nightshift-fulfillment, causing a retry storm and blocking queue progress. The message is not being sent to the dead-letter queue, indicating a persistent processing error.
proposed_actions: Investigate the root cause of the failure in nightshift-fulfillment for the message with correlation_id e3e1b203-111d-4766-9118-0e540742784c.
